description: Cascade/EMA utility scorer internal parameters. Loaded from utility_scorer.json if not inlined.

candidate_depths.description: K values to evaluate during Cascade test phase

test_iterations.description: Iterations per K during Cascade test phase

set_iterations.description: Iterations to hold best K during Cascade set phase

convergence_tolerance.description: Early exit when utility values converge within this fraction

backoff_multiplier.description: Multiply set duration by this when speculation unprofitable

ema_alpha.description: EMA decay for per-K utility tracking (Cascade) and acceptance length (EMA strategy)

ema_up_threshold.description: Hysteresis for EMA strategy depth increase (sglang-style)

ema_down_threshold.description: Hysteresis for EMA strategy depth decrease (sglang-style)

coverage_discount_floor.description: Minimum coverage discount for INV-A MoE-Spec degradation
